column3: Ayase Route ・ Bad End
It's a lie.
Eh?
Me dating Onii-san was all just a big lie.
Ahaha... Geez, Kirino, we had you completely fooled.
If I said that, you would be satisfied, right?
Eh? A-Ayase...?
That's right. I love you the most, Kirino. You know that too, right?
Hehe, you're so sneaky. You're trying to make me give up on Onii-san, all so you can have him for yourself, aren't you?
T-That's not...
Don't lie!
H-Hey, Ayase...!
Onii-san, that goes for you too. You see our relationship as a lie, don't you?
N-No, that's not...
Lies! If not, why didn't you deny it right away?!
And when I said we should tell Kirino about us, you were against it...
It was all a lie, wasn't it? And you even said you loved me!
More than Manami-san, more than Kuroneko-san, more than Kirino... You said you loved me the most! So it was all a lie!
You were always there to support me, you talked to me lovingly... You even went as far as saying you wanted to marry me.
I was happy. I was so very happy. But it was all a lie... All fake.
You traitor! I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!
I never got a chance to explain through Ayase's wailing.
As I was losing consciousness...
The last thing I ever saw was the figure of my beloved.
BAD END
